title: Crossref normalized raw records
description: Schema for the normalized record snapshot stored in crossref_records.json.

paper_id.description: DOI supplied by Crossref; used as the raw record identifier.

title.description: First title from Crossref, normalized for whitespace and tags.

summary.description: Abstract from Crossref, with HTML/JATS tags removed.

authors.description: Author names extracted from Crossref; empty when unavailable.

categories.description: Crossref subject values; empty when unavailable.

primary_category.description: First category, or an empty string when no category exists.

published.description: Published date normalized to ISO YYYY-MM-DD; empty when unavailable.

updated.description: Latest source update date normalized to ISO YYYY-MM-DD; empty when unavailable.

abs_url.description: Crossref URL, or a DOI URL fallback.

pdf_url.description: PDF link when Crossref provides one; otherwise empty.

comment.description: Container/journal and bibliographic details assembled from Crossref; may be empty.

crossrefRecord.$comment: This is the normalized raw snapshot. Cleaning applies length thresholds, DOI/title deduplication, fallbacks, and derived fields afterward.
